title: Network Engineer

nodes.title: Networking Models: OSI 7-Layer & TCP/IP Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Physical, data link, network, transport, session, presentation, application layers
learning_objectives: Map real-world network protocols to their respective OSI layers
Analyze packet encapsulation and decapsulation across network hops
feynman_prompts: Explain how data encapsulation adds headers and footers as data moves down the OSI stack.
key_misconceptions: Confusing Layer 2 MAC address frame forwarding with Layer 3 IP packet routing

nodes.title: IPv4 / IPv6 Addressing, Subnetting & CIDR
nodes.subtitle: IPv4 classes, CIDR notation, subnet masks, network vs broadcast addresses, IPv6 basics
learning_objectives: Calculate usable host ranges and broadcast addresses from CIDR blocks (/24, /27)
Design efficient IP addressing schemes that minimize address waste
feynman_prompts: Why does a /28 subnet provide exactly 14 usable host IP addresses?
key_misconceptions: Assigning the network address or broadcast address directly to a host interface

nodes.title: Ethernet Switching, VLANs & Trunking
nodes.subtitle: MAC address learning, collision domains, broadcast domains, 802.1Q VLAN trunking
learning_objectives: Segment corporate network traffic using 802.1Q tagged VLANs
Configure trunk and access ports on managed enterprise switches
feynman_prompts: How do VLANs isolate broadcast domains within the same physical switch?
key_misconceptions: Allowing native VLAN mismatch across trunk links, causing security leaks

nodes.title: Spanning Tree Protocol (STP & RSTP)
nodes.subtitle: Switching loops, broadcast storms, root bridge election, port states, Rapid STP (802.1w)
learning_objectives: Prevent switching loops and broadcast storms in redundant switch topologies
Optimize root bridge election and configure RSTP portfast for edge hosts
feynman_prompts: Explain how a switching loop causes catastrophic broadcast storms in under 1 second.
key_misconceptions: Connecting redundant physical switch links without enabling STP

nodes.title: IP Routing: Static Routing & Subnet Forwarding
nodes.subtitle: Default gateways, routing tables, longest prefix match, administrative distance
learning_objectives: Configure static routes and default routes (0.0.0.0/0) on enterprise routers
Diagnose routing black holes using traceroute and route table inspection
feynman_prompts: How does a router determine the next-hop using the longest prefix match rule?
key_misconceptions: Assuming routers forward packets without verifying a valid return route path

nodes.title: Interior Dynamic Routing: OSPF Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Link-state routing, Dijkstra shortest path algorithm, OSPF areas, LSA types, DR/BDR
learning_objectives: Deploy single-area and multi-area OSPF routing across enterprise networks
Configure OSPF hello timers, router IDs, and DR/BDR elections
feynman_prompts: Why does OSPF use link-state advertisements (LSAs) rather than distance-vector metrics?
key_misconceptions: Failing to connect non-backbone OSPF areas to Area 0

nodes.title: Exterior Gateway Protocol: BGP & Autonomous Systems
nodes.subtitle: Autonomous Systems (AS), eBGP vs iBGP, path vector attributes (AS_PATH, Local Pref, MED)
learning_objectives: Establish eBGP peering sessions and advertise network prefixes to upstream ISPs
Control outbound traffic flows using BGP Local Preference attributes
feynman_prompts: Explain how BGP prevents routing loops between Autonomous Systems using the AS_PATH attribute.
key_misconceptions: Accidentally becoming an open transit AS by leaking private routing tables to public peers

nodes.title: Core Network Services: DHCP & DNS Infrastructure
nodes.subtitle: DHCP DORA process, DHCP relay agents, DNS recursive vs iterative queries, authoritative servers
learning_objectives: Configure high-availability DHCP scopes and IP helper/relay addresses
Deploy and troubleshoot enterprise DNS name resolution infrastructure
feynman_prompts: Explain the four-step DORA process (Discover, Offer, Request, Acknowledge) in DHCP.
key_misconceptions: Forgetting to configure DHCP relay agents when DHCP servers reside in a different VLAN

nodes.title: Network Address Translation (NAT) & Port Forwarding
nodes.subtitle: Static NAT, Dynamic NAT, Port Address Translation (PAT / Overload), NAT traversal
learning_objectives: Configure PAT (NAT overload) allowing thousands of private hosts to share a public IP
Set up static NAT port forwarding for public-facing servers
feynman_prompts: Why was Port Address Translation (PAT) essential to prevent IPv4 address exhaustion?
key_misconceptions: Assuming NAT provides complete security without explicit stateful firewall rules

nodes.title: Network Access Control Lists (ACLs) & Firewalls
nodes.subtitle: Standard vs extended ACLs, stateful firewall inspection, zone-based policy firewalls
learning_objectives: Author restrictive extended ACLs filtering by source/dest IP and TCP/UDP ports
Deploy stateful firewall inspection rules separating untrusted from trusted zones
feynman_prompts: Why should standard ACLs be placed near the destination while extended ACLs go near the source?
key_misconceptions: Placing a permit-all rule before specific deny rules in an ordered ACL

nodes.title: Site-to-Site & Remote Access VPNs (IPsec / WireGuard)
nodes.subtitle: IPsec Phase 1 (IKE) and Phase 2, ESP, Tunnel vs Transport mode, modern WireGuard
learning_objectives: Establish secure IPsec site-to-site VPN tunnels connecting branch offices to cloud VPCs
Configure cryptographic transform sets and pre-shared key / certificate authentication
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between IPsec Tunnel mode (new IP header) and Transport mode?
key_misconceptions: Mismatched IKE Phase 1 lifetime or encryption proposals causing tunnel negotiation failures

nodes.title: Enterprise Wireless Networking (Wi-Fi)
nodes.subtitle: 802.11 standards (Wi-Fi 6/6E/7), 2.4GHz vs 5GHz, WPA3 enterprise, Roaming, SSIDs
learning_objectives: Design enterprise Wi-Fi coverage avoiding co-channel interference
Implement WPA3 Enterprise authentication with RADIUS and 802.1X
feynman_prompts: Why is channel overlap in the 2.4GHz band (channels 1, 6, 11) a primary cause of Wi-Fi performance drops?
key_misconceptions: Deploying access points with maximum transmit power, causing sticky client roaming issues

nodes.title: Network Monitoring: SNMP, NetFlow & Telemetry
nodes.subtitle: SNMPv3 polling, MIBs, OIDs, NetFlow / sFlow traffic analysis, bandwidth utilization
learning_objectives: Monitor interface link saturation and error discards using SNMPv3
Analyze top talkers and protocol distribution across WAN links using NetFlow
feynman_prompts: Why should network administrators use SNMPv3 instead of legacy SNMPv1/v2c?
key_misconceptions: Using default 'public' community strings on enterprise network equipment

nodes.title: Deep Packet Analysis & Troubleshooting with Wireshark
nodes.subtitle: Packet dissection, TCP windowing, retransmissions, zero window, filtering syntax
learning_objectives: Diagnose application latency bottlenecks by identifying TCP zero window and retransmissions
Filter and isolate malicious traffic patterns during network outages
feynman_prompts: How do TCP duplicate ACKs and retransmissions indicate packet loss on an intermediate link?
key_misconceptions: Assuming high ping latency always indicates network failure without checking host CPU saturation

nodes.title: Quality of Service (QoS) & Traffic Shaping
nodes.subtitle: Classification & marking (DSCP, CoS), queuing (WFQ, CBWFQ), policing vs shaping, VoIP prioritization
learning_objectives: Prioritize real-time voice and video packets (VoIP) using Expedited Forwarding (EF)
Configure traffic shaping to prevent bursty traffic from exceeding ISP committed rates
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between traffic policing (drops excess) and traffic shaping (buffers excess)?
key_misconceptions: Configuring QoS markings that get stripped at the ISP WAN boundary

nodes.title: Network Automation with Python & Netmiko
nodes.subtitle: SSH automation with Netmiko/Paramiko, parsing CLI output with TextFSM, NAPALM, Jinja2 templating
learning_objectives: Automate configuration backups and bulk VLAN changes across 50 switches with Python
Generate standardized device configurations dynamically using Jinja2 templates
feynman_prompts: Why is automated configuration generation using templates superior to manual CLI copy-pasting?
key_misconceptions: Deploying automated configuration scripts across all production switches simultaneously without testing

nodes.title: Infrastructure as Code for Networks with Ansible
nodes.subtitle: Ansible network modules, playbooks, inventory variables, idempotency in networking
learning_objectives: Execute idempotent configuration management on Cisco/Juniper devices with Ansible
Maintain version-controlled network configuration repositories in Git
feynman_prompts: How does Ansible achieve agentless network automation over SSH?
key_misconceptions: Executing raw CLI command tasks instead of using declarative Ansible network modules

nodes.title: Cloud Networking & Hybrid Connectivity
nodes.subtitle: AWS VPC, transit gateways, direct connect / express route, peering, cloud firewalls
learning_objectives: Design multi-region cloud VPC hub-and-spoke topologies with AWS Transit Gateway
Configure dedicated hybrid interconnects (AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute)
feynman_prompts: Why is a Transit Gateway preferred over complex full-mesh VPC peering in large enterprise clouds?
key_misconceptions: Overlapping CIDR blocks across on-premises and cloud VPC subnets, preventing IP routing

description: Master Network Engineer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
